title: The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter
author: anonymous

beats.event: Bamboo cutter finds an infant the size of his thumb inside a glowing stalk
Childless couple joyfully adopt her as Nayotake-no-Kaguya-hime
Within three months she grows into a woman of extraordinary beauty
Word of her beauty draws marriage proposals from many nobles
Five high-ranking suitors petition for her hand
She sets each an impossible legendary quest to earn her
First suitor's fake stone bowl is exposed for lacking holy light
Second suitor's fabricated jeweled branch is exposed by craftsmen demanding pay
Third suitor's supposedly fireproof robe burns in testing
Fourth suitor gives up after a storm at sea
Fifth suitor falls reaching into a swallow's nest
The Emperor courts her; she declines, citing her earthly origin
Three years of letters pass without her consent
Full moonlight brings her tears and inexplicable grief
She reveals she is a Moon dweller who must return home
Heavenly beings descend and escort her back to the Moon
She leaves an elixir of immortality with the Emperor
The Emperor has the elixir burned atop Mount Fuji
